description_en: Modifies the PolarFS S3 account policy
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-lakebase-s3-account-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pfs-instance-id pfs-xxx --user-acc-ak accname --user-acc-policy '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"]}]}' --api-version 2017-08-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLakebaseS3AccountPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to view the regions of all clusters under the target account
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看目标账号下所有的集群的地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The PolarFS instance ID. You can call the DescribePolarFs operation to query available instances and their IDs
parameters.help_zh: PolarFS 实例 ID。可通过 DescribePolarFs 查询可用实例及其 ID
parameters.name: pfs_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The access key of the S3 account whose policy you want to modify.

You cannot modify the default account.

You can call the ListLakebaseS3Accounts operation to obtain the account access key. Select an account with AccountType set to user
parameters.help_zh:
要修改策略的 S3 账户 Access Key。

不支持修改默认账号。

可通过 ListLakebaseS3Accounts 获取账户 Access Key；请选择 AccountType=user 的账户
parameters.name: user_acc_ak

parameters.help_en: The user account policy in JSON object format. The Version and Statement fields are required. Statement.Action must specify explicit actions such as s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject. The s3:* wildcard is not supported. Statement.Resource must specify explicit ARNs such as arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/. A standalone asterisk () is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 用户账户策略，采用 JSON 对象格式。Version 和 Statement 为必填字段；Statement.Action 应使用具体操作（如 s3:GetObject、s3:PutObject），不支持 s3:* 通配符；Statement.Resource 应使用具体 ARN（如 arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*），不支持单独使用 *
parameters.name: user_acc_policy
